items.question: Where do the fix rounds for a red or conflicted run PR land?
options: The merge stage only; the implementation phase's reconcile loop stays as is
Replace the implementation phase's three reconcile rounds with two
One shared cap across the reconcile loop and the merge stage

items.question: How does the security pass for a sensitive spec run?
options: A separate verifier step after the end-to-end verification passes, on gate B sensitive-path flags only
A section inside the end-to-end verification brief
A separate step that also fires on sensitive files found in the diff

items.question: Which model do implementer steps outside a task (repair, reconcile, merge fix) use?
options: The Opus tier only when the spec has any sensitive-path flag

items.question: What decides that a task's implementer runs on the Opus tier?
options: Recompute gate B class (a) sensitive-path items from the current tasks document at each step

items.question: What is the money, personal-data-and-erasure, and legal/compliance posture (refunds and forfeiture, credits, legal framing)?
options: n/a — the spec touches no money, personal data, or legal surface
